# Vendored libraries

- `three.module.js`: three.js r160, MIT licence (Copyright 2010-2023 Three.js Authors). Used by the workshop's 3D
  stage (`hud/workshop-frame.html`). Same file HOLO ships in its own `vendor` folder.
- `GLTFExporter.js`, `TextureUtils.js`: three.js r160 examples (MIT), with their imports pointed at the files in this
  folder. Used by the workshop to save a model as a .glb file.
